title: Ghost Hand
synopsis: This is Part 7 of our rendition of “Ghost Hand”.

fullText.simplified:
霍桑答应三天后再来。但其实他第二天就已经来了。奇怪的是，他没有在白天来，而是在深夜的时候，偷偷地来了。
    那天晚上深夜两点，他来到这个三层楼的小洋楼，抬起头，干咳了一声。那第三层楼的一个房间的灯马上亮了起来。不到两分钟，这个小洋楼的后门开了。一个黑影抬头看了一下霍桑，然后霍桑跟着这个黑影进了屋里。
    霍桑跟着这个黑影，轻轻地爬上了三楼。黑暗中，这个黑影似乎在发抖。
    到了第三层楼，这位大侦探不知从哪里变出了一把万能钥匙，轻轻松松就把房间的门锁打开了。霍桑让黑影进去后，自己也走进了房间。他轻轻地把门关上，然后又开了灯。因为这个房间有很厚的窗帘，所以外面的人看不到灯光。
    灯光中，那个黑影还在发抖，她就是侍女小凤。霍桑像回到自己家一样，找了一个最舒服的沙发坐下后，笑着对小凤说：“请坐！”
    小凤还在发抖，看起来很紧张。
    霍桑看了她一眼，说：“今天这个情形，和你前天晚上带那个姓朱的进来时的情形，有些相同吧？”
    侍女低着头，没有说话。
    “不过前天晚上，你们并没有到这第三层楼来。那个姓朱的，他约你一起进主人的房间，偷主人脖子上的小宝物。他答应事成后给你什么？钻石，是不是？不过我有一点不太明白，你们准备的迷药，为什么不用？胆小吗？”
    侍女还是没有回答。
    “哈哈！小凤，朱龙！你叫凤，他叫龙。你们还真是很合适的一对啊！你的小情人，今天不来吗？”霍桑开玩笑道。
    侍女小凤站在对面，低着头，本来就很红的脸，变得更红了。
    其实，这位大侦探刚来时并不确定自己猜得对不对，但从这侍女的反应上来看，他是猜对了。
    最后，霍桑看了看手表，说：“开始干正事吧！”
    他从沙发上站起来，走到那座盖着红布的铜像前面，拿下红布。然后，他从他的口袋里拿出了一个小袋子，把一个小东西从小袋子里倒了出来。那是一条小龙，和李时脖子上那条小金龙的形状很像。但这条小龙不是金的，而是用铁做成的。
    原来，那天霍桑带着小金龙去洗手间洗手的时候，把那条小金龙按在两块香皂中间，得到了一个小金龙的印子。然后再用那个印子，做成了现在这条小铁龙。
    霍桑小心地把小铁龙的头部，插到大铜像右边耳朵的小洞里，然后用力转了一下。他很兴奋地看着铜像，但铜像一动不动，没有半点反应。
    霍桑很失望。他在房间里走来走去，显得有些着急。他又认真地看了一遍铜像。最后他发现，这铜像右边耳朵的后面还有一个更小的小洞。
    这次，他把小铁龙的头部插到了这个小洞中，又用力转了好几下。突然，铜像的头部动了起来，然后慢慢地向后倒了下去。站在一旁的侍女小凤惊得说不出话来。他们都看到，铜像分开的头部和脖子中间，有一个小盒子。看来这么多年的秘密，都在这小盒子中了。
fullText.traditional:
霍桑答應三天後再來。但其實他第二天就已經來了。奇怪的是，他沒有在白天來，而是在深夜的時候，偷偷地來了。
    那天晚上深夜兩點，他來到這個三層樓的小洋樓，抬起頭，乾咳了一聲。那第三層樓的一個房間的燈馬上亮了起來。不到兩分鐘，這個小洋樓的後門開了。一個黑影抬頭看了一下霍桑，然後霍桑跟著這個黑影進了屋裡。
    霍桑跟著這個黑影，輕輕地爬上了三樓。黑暗中，這個黑影似乎在發抖。
    到了第三層樓，這位大偵探不知從哪裏變出了一把萬能鑰匙，輕輕鬆鬆就把房間的門鎖打開了。霍桑讓黑影進去後，自己也走進了房間。他輕輕地把門關上，然後又開了燈。因為這個房間有很厚的窗簾，所以外面的人看不到燈光。
    燈光中，那個黑影還在發抖，她就是侍女小鳳。霍桑像回到自己家一樣，找了一個最舒服的沙發坐下後，笑著對小鳳說：“請坐！”
    小鳳還在發抖，看起來很緊張。
    霍桑看了她一眼，說：“今天這個情形，和你前天晚上帶那個姓朱的進來時的情形，有些相同吧？”
    侍女低著頭，沒有說話。
    “不過前天晚上，你們並沒有到這第三層樓來。那個姓朱的，他約你一起進主人的房間，偷主人脖子上的小寶物。他答應事成後給你什麼？鑽石，是不是？不過我有一點不太明白，你們準備的迷藥，為什麼不用？膽小嗎？”
    侍女還是沒有回答。
    “哈哈！小鳳，朱龍！你叫鳳，他叫龍。你們還真是很合適的一對啊！你的小情人，今天不來嗎？”霍桑開玩笑道。
    侍女小鳳站在對面，低著頭，本來就很紅的臉，變得更紅了。
    其實，這位大偵探剛來時並不確定自己猜得對不對，但從這侍女的反應上來看，他是猜對了。
    最後，霍桑看了看手錶，說：“開始幹正事吧！”
    他從沙發上站起來，走到那座蓋著紅布的銅像前面，拿下紅布。然後，他從他的口袋裡拿出了一個小袋子，把一個小東西從小袋子裡倒了出來。那是一條小龍，和李時脖子上那條小金龍的形狀很像。但這條小龍不是金的，而是用鐵做成的。
    原來，那天霍桑帶著小金龍去洗手間洗手的時候，把那條小金龍按在兩塊香皂中間，得到了一個小金龍的印子。然後再用那個印子，做成了現在這條小鐵龍。
    霍桑小心地把小鐵龍的頭部，插到大銅像右邊耳朵的小洞裡，然後用力轉了一下。他很興奮地看著銅像，但銅像一動不動，沒有半點反應。
    霍桑很失望。他在房間裡走來走去，顯得有些著急。他又認真地看了一遍銅像。最後他發現，這銅像右邊耳朵的後面還有一個更小的小洞。
    這次，他把小鐵龍的頭部插到了這個小洞中，又用力轉了好幾下。突然，銅像的頭部動了起來，然後慢慢地向後倒了下去。站在一旁的侍女小鳳驚得說不出話來。他們都看到，銅像分開的頭部和脖子中間，有一個小盒子。看來這麼多年的秘密，都在這小盒子中了。

sentences.simplified: 最后，霍桑看了看手表，说：“开始干正事吧！”
sentences.traditional: 最後，霍桑看了看手錶，說：“開始幹正事吧！”
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu huò sāng kàn le kàn shǒu biǎo shuō kāi shǐ gàn zhèng shì ba
sentences.english: Finally, Huo Sang looked at his wristwatch, and said, “Let’s start doing proper business!”

sentences.simplified: 他从沙发上站起来，走到那座盖着红布的铜像前面，拿下红布。
sentences.traditional: 他從沙發上站起來，走到那座蓋著紅布的銅像前面，拿下紅布。
sentences.pinyin: tā cóng shā fā shang zhàn qǐ lái zǒu dào nà zuò gài zhe hóng bù de tóng xiàng qián miàn ná xià hóng bù
sentences.english: He stood up from the sofa, walked up in front of that bronze statue covered in red cloth, and took down the red cloth.

sentences.simplified: 然后，他从他的口袋里拿出了一个小袋子，把一个小东西从小袋子里倒了出来。
sentences.traditional: 然後，他從他的口袋裡拿出了一個小袋子，把一個小東西從小袋子裡倒了出來。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu tā cóng tā de kǒu dài lǐ ná chū le yí ge xiǎo dài zi bǎ yí ge xiǎo dōng xi cóng xiǎo dài zi lǐ dào le chū lái
sentences.english: Then, he took out a small pouch from inside his pocket, and something tiny came falling out from the small pouch.

sentences.simplified: 那是一条小龙，和李时脖子上那条小金龙的形状很像。
sentences.traditional: 那是一條小龍，和李時脖子上那條小金龍的形狀很像。
sentences.pinyin: nà shì yì tiáo xiǎo lóng hé lǐ shí bó zi shang nà tiáo xiǎo jīn lóng de xíng zhuàng hěn xiàng
sentences.english: That was a small dragon, shaped very much like that small golden dragon on Li Shi’s neck.

sentences.simplified: 但这条小龙不是金的，而是用铁做成的。
sentences.traditional: 但這條小龍不是金的，而是用鐵做成的。
sentences.pinyin: dàn zhè tiáo xiǎo lóng bú shì jīn de ér shì yòng tiě zuò chéng de
sentences.english: But this small dragon wasn’t golden, but rather made of iron.

sentences.simplified: 原来，那天霍桑带着小金龙去洗手间洗手的时候，
sentences.traditional: 原來，那天霍桑帶著小金龍去洗手間洗手的時候，
sentences.pinyin: yuán lái nà tiān huò sāng dài zhe xiǎo jīn lóng qù xǐ shǒu jiān xǐ shǒu de shí hou
sentences.english: As it turns out, when Huo Sang took the small golden dragon along to wash his hands in the washroom that day, ..

sentences.simplified: 把那条小金龙按在两块香皂中间，得到了一个小金龙的印子。
sentences.traditional: 把那條小金龍按在兩塊香皂中間，得到了一個小金龍的印子。
sentences.pinyin: bǎ nà tiáo xiǎo jīn lóng àn zài liǎng kuài xiāng zào zhōng jiān dé dào le yí ge xiǎo jīn lóng de yìn zi
sentences.english: .. he pressed that small golden dragon between two bars of perfumed soap and got an imprint of the small golden dragon.

sentences.simplified: 然后再用那个印子，做成了现在这条小铁龙。
sentences.traditional: 然後再用那個印子，做成了現在這條小鐵龍。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu zài yòng nà ge yìn zi zuò chéng le xiàn zài zhè tiáo xiǎo tiě lóng
sentences.english: After that he used that imprint again, to make this small iron dragon he had now.

sentences.simplified: 霍桑小心地把小铁龙的头部，
sentences.traditional: 霍桑小心地把小鐵龍的頭部，
sentences.pinyin: huò sāng xiǎo xīn de bǎ xiǎo tiě lóng de tóu bù
sentences.english: Huo Sang carefully took the small iron dragon’s head, ..

sentences.simplified: 插到大铜像右边耳朵的小洞里，然后用力转了一下。
sentences.traditional: 插到大銅像右邊耳朵的小洞裡，然後用力轉了一下。
sentences.pinyin: chā dào dà tóng xiàng yòu bian ěr duo de xiǎo dòng lǐ rán hòu yòng lì zhuàn le yí xià
sentences.english: .. inserted it in the small hole in the right ear of the big bronze statue, and forcefully turned it a bit.

sentences.simplified: 他很兴奋地看着铜像，但铜像一动不动，没有半点反应。
sentences.traditional: 他很興奮地看著銅像，但銅像一動不動，沒有半點反應。
sentences.pinyin: tā hěn xīng fèn de kàn zhe tóng xiàng dàn tóng xiàng yí dòng bú dòng méi yǒu bàn diǎn fǎn yìng
sentences.english: He watched the bronze statue very excitedly, but the bronze statue didn’t move one bit. It didn’t react in the least.

sentences.simplified: 霍桑很失望。
sentences.traditional: 霍桑很失望。
sentences.pinyin: huò sāng hěn shī wàng
sentences.english: Huo Sang was very disappointed.

sentences.simplified: 他在房间里走来走去，显得有些着急。
sentences.traditional: 他在房間裡走來走去，顯得有些著急。
sentences.pinyin: tā zài fáng jiān lǐ zǒu lái zǒu qù xiǎn de yǒu xiē zháo jí
sentences.english: He walked here and there in the room and seemed a bit anxious.

sentences.simplified: 他又认真地看了一遍铜像。
sentences.traditional: 他又認真地看了一遍銅像。
sentences.pinyin: tā yòu rèn zhēn de kàn le yí biàn tóng xiàng
sentences.english: He looked at the bronze statue earnestly one more time.

sentences.simplified: 最后他发现，这铜像右边耳朵的后面还有一个更小的小洞。
sentences.traditional: 最後他發現，這銅像右邊耳朵的後面還有一個更小的小洞。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu tā fā xiàn zhè tóng xiàng yòu bian ěr duo de hòu miàn hái yǒu yí ge gèng xiǎo de xiǎo dòng
sentences.english: Finally, he discovered that there was an even smaller hole still behind the right ear of this bronze statue.

sentences.simplified: 这次，他把小铁龙的头部插到了这个小洞中，
sentences.traditional: 這次，他把小鐵龍的頭部插到了這個小洞中，
sentences.pinyin: zhè cì tā bǎ xiǎo tiě lóng de tóu bù chā dào le zhè ge xiǎo dòng zhōng
sentences.english: This time, he inserted the head of the small iron dragon in this small hole, ..

sentences.simplified: 又用力转了好几下。
sentences.traditional: 又用力轉了好幾下。
sentences.pinyin: yòu yòng lì zhuàn le hǎo jǐ xià
sentences.english: .. and forcefully turned it again a good number of times.

sentences.simplified: 突然，铜像的头部动了起来，然后慢慢地向后倒了下去。
sentences.traditional: 突然，銅像的頭部動了起來，然後慢慢地向後倒了下去。
sentences.pinyin: tū rán tóng xiàng de tóu bù dòng le qǐ lái rán hòu màn man de xiàng hòu dǎo le xià qù
sentences.english: Suddenly, the head of the bronze statue started moving, and then slowly fell down backward.

sentences.simplified: 站在一旁的侍女小凤惊得说不出话来。
sentences.traditional: 站在一旁的侍女小鳳驚得說不出話來。
sentences.pinyin: zhàn zài yì páng de shì nǚ xiǎo fèng jīng de shuō bù chū huà lái
sentences.english: Miss Xiaofeng standing to the side was so startled she couldn’t utter a word.

sentences.simplified: 他们都看到，铜像分开的头部和脖子中间，有一个小盒子。
sentences.traditional: 他們都看到，銅像分開的頭部和脖子中間，有一個小盒子。
sentences.pinyin: tā men dōu kàn dào tóng xiàng fēn kāi de tóu bù hé bó zi zhōng jiān yǒu yí ge xiǎo hé zi
sentences.english: They both saw, that between the separated head and neck of the bronze statue, there was a small box.

sentences.simplified: 看来这么多年的秘密，都在这小盒子中了。
sentences.traditional: 看來這麼多年的秘密，都在這小盒子中了。
sentences.pinyin: kàn lái zhè me duō nián de mì mì dōu zài zhè xiǎo hé zi zhōng le
sentences.english: It seemed like the secret of so many years, was all in this small box.

raw.synopsis: This is Part 7 of our rendition of “Ghost Hand”.
sentence_translations: Huo Sang agreed to come again in three days. But in fact, he already came the next day.
The strange thing was, he didn't come during the day, but rather when it was late at night, and he came stealthily.
At 2 AM that night, he arrived at this small three-story Western-style house, lifted his head, and gave a dry cough.
The light in a room of that three-story house started shining right away.
In less than two minutes, the back door of this small Western-style house opened.
A shadow raised its head to look at Huo Sang for a bit.
Then Huo Sang followed this shadow and went inside the house.
Huo Sang followed after this shadow and lightly went up to the third floor.
This shadow seemed to tremble in the darkness.
Arriving on the third floor, this great detective produced a master key from somewhere.
He effortlessly opened the door lock to the room.
Huo Sang let the shadow go in and then he also walked into the room.
He lightly closed the door, then also turned on the light.
Because this room had very thick window curtains, the result was that people outside couldn’t see the light shining.
In the light, that shadow was still trembling. She was the maid Miss Xiaofeng.
Huo Sang acted like he was coming back to his own home.
After he looked for the most comfortable sofa and sat down, he said to Xiaofeng with a smile: “Please sit!”
Xiaofeng was still trembling and looked very tense.
Huo Sang gave her a glance and said:
“These circumstances today, and the circumstances when you took Zhu inside the night before yesterday, ..
.. they have some similarities, right?”
The young lady let her head droop and didn’t say anything.
“But the night before yesterday, you didn’t come to this third floor at all.
That Zhu, he made a pact with you to go into the owner’s room together, and steal the small treasure on the owner’s neck.
What did he agree to give you when the thing was done? Diamonds, wasn’t it?
But there’s something I don’t understand that well.
The knockout drops you prepared, why not use them? Cowardice?”
The young lady still wasn’t answering.
“Haha! Xiaofeng, Zhu Long! You‘re called phoenix, he‘s called dragon. You really are a very suitable pair!
Your little sweetheart didn’t come today?” Huo Sang said as a joke.
Miss Xiaofeng stood directly in front of him, head lowered. Her already very red face now got even redder.
Actually, just as this great detective arrived he wasn’t sure at all if his guess was correct or not.
But by looking at the reaction of this young lady, he had guessed correctly.
Finally, Huo Sang looked at his wristwatch, and said, “Let’s start doing proper business!”
He stood up from the sofa, walked up in front of that bronze statue covered in red cloth, and took down the red cloth.
Then, he took out a small pouch from inside his pocket, and something tiny came falling out from the small pouch.
That was a small dragon, shaped very much like that small golden dragon on Li Shi’s neck.
But this small dragon wasn’t golden, but rather made of iron.
As it turns out, when Huo Sang took the small golden dragon along to wash his hands in the washroom that day, ..
.. he pressed that small golden dragon between two bars of perfumed soap and got an imprint of the small golden dragon.
After that he used that imprint again, to make this small iron dragon he had now.
Huo Sang carefully took the small iron dragon’s head, ..
.. inserted it in the small hole in the right ear of the big bronze statue, and forcefully turned it a bit.
He watched the bronze statue very excitedly, but the bronze statue didn’t move one bit. It didn’t react in the least.
Huo Sang was very disappointed.
He walked here and there in the room and seemed a bit anxious.
He looked at the bronze statue earnestly one more time.
Finally, he discovered that there was an even smaller hole still behind the right ear of this bronze statue.
This time, he inserted the head of the small iron dragon in this small hole, ..
.. and forcefully turned it again a good number of times.
Suddenly, the head of the bronze statue started moving, and then slowly fell down backward.
Miss Xiaofeng standing to the side was so startled she couldn’t utter a word.
They both saw, that between the separated head and neck of the bronze statue, there was a small box.
It seemed like the secret of so many years, was all in this small box.
